title: The Finalist Pitch: Leading TaladHub to the Top 6 in the Tuek Som Garage project
image1Description: Atmosphere of the business plan presentation (Pitching) on the Top 6 selection stage

section1.heading: Origin and Intent
section1.content: Entering the Top 6 selection round was the most intense test in the Tuek Som Garage project. As the leader of team 'TaladHub', I intended to prove to the judges that our solution was not created from imagination, but from going to the real field to listen to the voices of all stakeholders. I was determined to present a platform that is the answer for modern market management, which must balance both business and traditional lifestyle.

section2.heading: Role and Action
section2.content: I served as the Leader and Main Pitcher on the judging day. I took all the data from the MVP, market surveys, and deep interviews with both market owners and vendors to summarize into a real strategy. I presented a Total Solution that covers both the back-end system for management and digital marketing media to attract consumers. I also showed the prototype website and the Branding plan we already started, showing our readiness to develop into a full-scale real Product.

section3.heading: Challenges
section3.content: The main challenge was gathering complex data from many sectors (Multi-stakeholder) and telling the story within a limited time. I had to make the judges see how TaladHub would help 'market owners' manage more easily, help 'vendors' have stable income, and help 'consumers' get a good experience. Answering deep questions about the business model and technical possibility under high pressure was a great proof of my expertise and confidence in the project.

section4.heading: Results and Learning
section4.content: With hard preparation and a presentation that met the needs, team TaladHub successfully won over the judges and reached the Top 6. This experience developed my Leadership and Strategic Pitching skills to another level. I learned that Startup success does not depend on whose idea is the most advanced, but on who can 'solve real problems' and 'communicate that most clearly.' This is the important foundation I will use to lead the project to success in the next level.
